text:
zoe-sec: Alert: responsible disclosure received for an XML external entity (XXE) variant in the SSO metadata importer used by Private and some Dedicated installs. Tracked as CVE-2026-4201.

zoe-sec: Impact: installs with `sso.importAutomation=true` and clusters running the metadata-sync cron could fetch malicious metadata. Hosted API customers are not affected.

han: Thanks. Immediate mitigation?

zoe-sec: Mitigation steps: 1) set `sso.importAutomation=false`, 2) deploy patched image `redwood/sso-importer:1.8.3-patch`, 3) rotate any federated certs imported in the last 30 days.

ops-bot: Build complete: `redwood/sso-importer:1.8.3-patch` (signed). Canary/CD pipeline queued.

laila-cs: I'll draft customer advisory and provide an opt-in for assisted remediation.

ev an-legal: Please include a legal statement for regulated customers confirming no user credentials were accessed and provide the escalation contact.

han: Disable commands?

zoe-sec: Dedicated control plane: `kubectl -n redwood-system patch configmap sso-config -p '{"data":{"importAutomation":"false"}}'`
Helm/on-prem: `helm upgrade --set sso.importAutomation=false redwood-private ./chart`

han: Running disable against the high-risk tenant list now.

zoe-sec: Timeline: emergency disable within 2 hours; canary rollout in 6 hours (monitor auth traces for 1 hour); full rollout in 36 hours. Postmortem and internal summary within 7 days.

laila-cs: Noted, starting outbound comms to affected accounts.

zoe-sec: File ticket SEC-9024 for tracking and add telemetry query to search for external entity requests over the last 90 days. Ping me on urgent if you see anomalous auth failures.
